title: UPSSSC PET 2026 Syllabus
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF from portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF
3. Download UPSSSC PET 2026 Syllabus

shortDescription: UPSSSC PET 2026 Syllabus – full topic list for Preliminary Eligibility Test.
content:
UPSSSC PET 2026 is a screening exam used for shortlisting candidates for various group-C recruitments.

Syllabus areas (typical)

  • Indian History & National Movement
  • Indian Geography / World Geography (basic)
  • Indian Economy & Social Development
  • Indian Constitution & Public Administration
  • General Science
  • Elementary Arithmetic
  • General Hindi
  • General English
  • Logic & Reasoning
  • Current Affairs
  • General Awareness & UP-specific topics as notified

Exact scheme is in the PET 2026 advertisement on upsssc.gov.in.
